Package logic

Class LoginResult

java.lang.Object
logic.LoginResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LoginResult extends Object implements Serializable
immutable value object returned by the server after a successful login.

carries the user's role, name, email, ID, and optional park assignment. sent as the payload of LOGIN_SUCCESS and stored in UserSession.

    • LoginResult

      public LoginResult(String role, String firstName, String lastName, String email, String userId, Integer parkId)
      Parameters:
      role - the application role constant (e.g., "VISITOR", "PARK_EMPLOYEE")
      firstName - the user's first name
      lastName - the user's last name
      email - the user's contact email address
      userId - visitor id_number or staff username
      parkId - the assigned park ID for employees/managers, or null
